_note: Which of the 'ours' decisions each SHARED (upstream-backed) component must implement. Transcribed from docs/plans/2026-09-18-shadcn-reset/implementation.md § 5.2, which measured each row against the pinned upstream source. verify-parity.mjs fails a migrated component whose patch header omits a 'required' ID assigned to it, and fails any patch naming an ID that is not 'ours' in decisions.json. Decisions with no entry here are global (they live in base.css, the tokens or the preset) or apply only to our own extras. TYP-14 assigns issue #148's operator-approved smaller fallback typography to Avatar. Two lists have grown since. A11Y-9 gained 'toast' (Batch 5, 2026-09-18). A11Y-13 gained 'attachment' and 'bubble' (Batch 6, 2026-09-18): the row is the RULE that a soft status surface reads through the family's `-text` ink rather than its fill, not a list of four components, and both are the identical pair MEASURED under the AA floor A11Y-1 enforces — upstream's `text-destructive` on its own `/10` tint is 3.987:1 in light, and `text-destructive/80` on `card` is 4.116:1. Batch 2 set the precedent when it extended the same row to Badge's tinted variants and flagged it for MK; both of these are flagged the same way. § 5.2 measured A11Y-9 against the four modal surfaces, but the row states the invariant, not the surface — content hidden from assistive technology must not be reachable by keyboard — and Base UI's high-priority toast is the same defect on a non-modal surface. No new row was added; the existing one was applied where it holds. The hardening pass after the Codex review of `main..HEAD` (2026-09-18) made two more changes. A11Y-9 gained `combobox`: while its popup is open Base UI marks the whole trailing addon `aria-hidden="true"`, and the toggle button inside it stayed tabbable — the same defect as the toast one, on a third kind of surface, so the same row covers it and the axe suppression that had RECORDED it is gone. A11Y-16 is new — MK added the row to the register on 2026-09-18 after the review found that `slider` and `combobox` had recorded their accessible-name hunks under A11Y-5, whose letter is the `sr-only ", "` separator between sibling name parts and does not authorise naming a control. The fixes were correct; only the citation moved. IDs A11Y-14 and A11Y-15 are permanently unused. The closing pass (2026-09-18) added OVL-14, the row MK approved to restore the fullscreen portal container Batch 4 lost: `tooltip` and `dropdown-menu` forward an optional `container` to their Base UI portal, so chrome drawn over a fullscreen surface can portal INTO it instead of to `document.body`, which the Fullscreen API paints over. `media-player-controls` is its only consumer; every other caller leaves the prop unset and keeps upstream's default. ICO-8 is new (MK, 2026-09-22): lucide `Loader` replaces `Loader2`/`LoaderCircle` as the one indeterminate loading mark, so `spinner` and `toast` each carry a one-import hunk under it (`sonner` did too, until it was retired later the same day — see below). `status-icon` is ours, not upstream-backed, and already drew `Loader`; upstream's dashboard block (removed since, DS-78) already imported `LoaderIcon`, so neither needed a hunk. Sonner was retired on 2026-09-22 (OVL-10 flips to **ours**): Toast is the one notification engine, so the component, its patch and its assignments here are gone. OVL-15 and COL-23 are new on that date and both belong to `toast` — OVL-15 is its position prop, the anchored Positioner/Arrow parts and its z-60 band; COL-23 gives a description-only toast the default ink, because Base UI renders the title as null when there is none and upstream's flat muted description then painted the toast's only line in the secondary ink. BRD-1 is new here (MK reversed it to ours, 23-09-2026, docs/plans/2026-09-23-consumer-alignment-fixes.md §1): every card and floating surface that took upstream's `ring-1 ring-foreground/10` draws `border border-border` instead; MK extended it to the floating sidebar the same day, whose `ring-sidebar-border` edge becomes `border border-sidebar-border`. OVL-16 is new (MK, 23-09-2026, a consumer gap): `DialogContent` takes a `size` prop (sm/default/lg/xl via `data-size`) mirroring AlertDialogContent, so it belongs to `dialog` alone. API-27 is new (MK, 24-09-2026, facelift DS-40): `combobox` re-exports Base UI's `Combobox.Status` as `ComboboxStatus`, screen-reader-only unless `visible`, so it belongs to `combobox` alone. API-28 is new (MK, 24-09-2026, facelift DS-44): `attachment` widens its scope — `AttachmentGroup layout="scroll" | "grid"`, a new `AttachmentProgress` composed from the `progress` parts, a `muted` tile, and image styling that reaches a nested `` — so it belongs to `attachment` alone. A11Y-13 gained the three menus (their destructive item's focused ink on its own `/10` tint is the identical 3.99:1 pair) and `questionnaire` (its error copy is the identical pair to Field's error copy, which the row names); both extensions are flagged for MK, as Batches 2 and 6 were.
_advisory: implementation.md § 5.2 states A11Y-2's list as 'candidates — audit each', not as an assignment. Auditing is the per-component judgement the batch makes, so the gate reports these and does not fail on them. Everything under 'required' is an assignment.
